notes: *the rest of ... their slain* is kept as one rendering of ḥallēy under rule 31, headed on *slain*; the competing reading marks *the rest* an added supply, and the packet prints no italic either way, which by rule 7 corroborates nothing.
The waw is rendered *also* postpositively (rule 51), and the fronted *did* stays with hārəgû, discontinuous around the subject.
